lede: The biggest item this week is a joint HARC and P&Z special session Monday that takes up proposed Land Use Code and Design Guidelines changes to bring Telluride into compliance with the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — whatever language they recommend heads straight to Town Council. Also worth watching: the Telluride Hospital District board sits down Thursday for a substantive discussion on mill levy considerations as the push for a new facility continues. Elsewhere, the week fills out with the Yoga Festival kicking off, the Oak Street Park SummerSHOW Series starting Thursday with Elder Grown, and the Sunset Concert Series Wednesday.

notable.stake: Recommended wildfire code language shapes what Town Council will vote on.
Mill levy discussion directly affects how the hospital district is funded.
Early public shaping of the major Town-owned Shandoka lot redevelopment proposal.
